$comment: The one list of games on the site. tools/sync-games.mjs writes the footer Games column on every page, the More Free Games cards on the front page, and the game entries in sitemap.xml from it — so adding a game is one entry here plus `npm run sync`, and tools/site-check.mjs then checks every page listed. Order here is display order.

card.alt: Solitaire table with big, easy-to-read cards
card.desc: The classic card game with big cards — tap a card and it moves by itself.

card.alt: FreeCell table with eight columns of big, easy-to-read cards
card.desc: Every deal can be solved — four free cells and a little patience.

card.alt: Word search grid with large letters and highlighted words
card.desc: Find the hidden words on a big, clear grid — a new puzzle every day.

card.alt: Five in a Row board with black and white stones
card.desc: Line up five stones on a big, easy-to-see board.

card.alt: Backgammon board with ivory and burgundy checkers and two dice
card.desc: Roll the dice and bring your checkers home, against a gentle computer.

card.alt: Four Ball Billiards table with a white cue ball and two red balls
card.desc: Carom billiards on a table with no pockets — hit both reds to score.

card.alt: Pool table with the balls racked and the cue ball ready
card.desc: Line up your shot on a big green table — solids, stripes, then the black.

card.alt: StoneFlick table with light and dark stones
card.desc: Flick your stones across the table and knock the other side's off.

card.alt: Table shuffleboard with red and blue weights on a maple board
card.desc: Slide your weights down a long maple board into the scoring zones.
